nodes.description: Public provenance hash string for the collection (VOG_PROVENANCE).
Constant price per gem, 0.0808 ETH (80800000000000000 wei).
Constant maximum number of NFTs mintable in a single purchase (20).
Maximum total supply of gems (12345).
Boolean flag controlling whether public minting is enabled.
Randomized starting index used for provenance shuffling.
Block number captured for later pseudo-random starting index derivation.
Private base URI prefix used by _baseURI and tokenURI.
Mapping from tokenId to individual token URI override.
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
onlyOwner function that toggles the saleIsActive flag.
onlyOwner function that forwards the whole contract balance to msg.sender via transfer.
onlyOwner function minting up to 30 reserved tokens to the caller and seeding startingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner function minting a caller-specified number of reserved tokens to an arbitrary address.
Payable public mint function enforcing sale state, supply cap, per-purchase cap and exact ETH payment.
onlyOwner function deriving the pseudo-random startingIndex from a past blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
onlyOwner function storing the provenance hash.
onlyOwner fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Internal view override returning the stored extended base URI.
onlyOwner function updating the base URI used for metadata.
View function building the metadata URI from base URI, per-token URI and token id.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name 'Vault Of Gems' and symbol 'VOG'.
Internal ERC721 mint helper that transfers a token and calls the recipient callback.
Untrusted caller address used as mint recipient, withdrawal recipient and owner check.
Native ETH transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) performed in withdraw.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received triggered by _safeMint, handing control to the recipient.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in mintGem.
Recipient address for reserved tokens in reserveGems.
Number of reserved tokens to mint in reserveGems.
Provenance hash string passed to setProvenanceHash.
New base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
Token id argument of the tokenURI view function.
Local variable holding totalSupply() during reserve minting.

edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender is the ETH recipient and trigger of withdraw.
withdraw executes payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) on the whole balance.
withdraw forwards the entire contract balance to the untrusted msg.sender.
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
withdraw is restricted by onlyOwner comparing _owner to _msgSender().
flipSaleState is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
reserveTokens is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
reserveGems is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
calcStartingIndex is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setProvenanceHash is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setBaseURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
mintGem requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintGem mints every newly created token to the untrusted msg.sender.
mintGem consumes the numberOfTokens parameter in its checks and mint loop.
mintGem multiplies gemPrice by numberOfTokens and compares to msg.value.
mintGem adds totalSupply and numberOfTokens and compares against MAX_SUPPLY.
mintGem enforces the MAX_NFT_PURCHASE per-transaction limit.
mintGem calls _safeMint inside an unbounded-per-user loop.
Local loop counter i drives the minting loop of mintGem.
_safeMint performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
The recipient callback can re-enter mintGem before the loop and supply bookkeeping complete.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint for each reserved token.
reserveGems calls _safeMint for each reserved token.
reserveTokens mints the reserved tokens directly to msg.sender.
reserveTokens stores totalSupply() in the local supply variable.
reserveTokens writes startingIndexBlock when it is still zero.
reserveGems mints reserved tokens to the _to parameter.
reserveGems loops _reserveAmount times with no upper bound.
reserveGems stores totalSupply() in the local supply variable.
reserveGems writes startingIndexBlock when it is still zero.
calcStartingIndex derives and writes the startingIndex state variable.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to obtain a past blockhash.
calcStartingIndex reduces the blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY and adds one if zero.
setProvenanceHash writes the VOG_PROVENANCE state variable.
setProvenanceHash consumes the provenanceHash parameter.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock assigns block.number to startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to still be zero.
setBaseURI writes the private _baseURIExtended state variable.
setBaseURI consumes the baseURI_ parameter.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseURIExtended value.
tokenURI reads the per-token override from the _tokenURIs mapping.
tokenURI calls _baseURI() to obtain the base prefix.
tokenURI consumes the tokenId parameter for existence checks and concatenation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only flows into mintGem's supply, cap and payment checks and its mint loop.
Recipient parameter is only used by reserveGems when calling _safeMint.
Loop bound parameter is only meaningful inside reserveGems' minting loop.
Parameter is written straight into VOG_PROVENANCE by setProvenanceHash.
Parameter is written straight into _baseURIExtended by setBaseURI.
Token id parameter is only consumed inside the tokenURI view function.
Local supply cache of totalSupply() exists only during reserveTokens execution.
Local balance snapshot is read and transferred only inside withdraw.
Loop counter exists only to iterate the minting loop of mintGem.
